description: Modern, clean landing page for Petal GTD - a web-based GTD productivity application inspired by Things 3. Combines clean minimalism with modern animated elements using Aceternity UI components.

userStories.title: Project Setup and Configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to initialize the Next.js project with all required dependencies and configurations.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Next.js 14+ project with App Router (create-next-app)
Configure TypeScript strict mode
Install and configure Tailwind CSS with custom theme
Install Framer Motion for animations
Set up project structure: /app, /components, /lib, /constants, /public
Configure cn utility function for className merging (clsx + tailwind-merge)
Add Inter font configuration
Typecheck passes
Project runs successfully with npm run dev

userStories.title: Navbar Component
userStories.description: As a user, I want a clean navigation bar so I can access different sections and the signup button.
acceptanceCriteria: Create sticky navbar component at top of page
Display Petal GTD logo on the left
Navigation links: Features, Showcase, Pricing
Get Started / Sign Up button on the right with primary styling
Responsive: hamburger menu on mobile
Subtle background blur effect on scroll
Smooth scroll to sections on click
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Hero Section
userStories.description: As a user, I want an impactful hero section that immediately communicates what Petal GTD does and encourages me to sign up.
acceptanceCriteria: Large, bold headline: 'Get Things Done, Beautifully' or similar
Subheadline explaining the GTD workflow and Things 3-inspired design
Primary CTA button: 'Start for Free' linking to app signup
Secondary CTA button: 'Learn More' or 'Watch Demo'
Hero image/mockup showing the Petal GTD app interface (placeholder)
Subtle animated background (grid pattern or beams from Aceternity)
Responsive layout: stacked on mobile, side-by-side on desktop
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use Hero components from Aceternity UI Pro hero/ and backgrounds/

userStories.title: Features Section
userStories.description: As a user, I want to understand the key features of Petal GTD so I can evaluate if it meets my needs.
acceptanceCriteria: Section title: 'Everything you need to stay productive'
Display 6 key features in a grid or bento layout
Features: Inbox capture, Today view, Projects & Areas, Upcoming calendar, Tags/filtering, Dark/Light mode
Each feature has: icon, title, brief description
Subtle hover animations on feature cards
Responsive grid: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3 columns desktop
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use feature-sections or bento-grids from Aceternity UI Pro

userStories.title: App Showcase Section
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see what the actual application looks like so I can visualize using it.
acceptanceCriteria: Section title: 'A GTD experience you'll love'
Large placeholder screenshots/mockups of the app
Show multiple views: Today view, Inbox, Project detail (as tabs or carousel)
Browser-frame mockup wrapper for screenshots
Subtle shadow and depth effects
Responsive: full-width on mobile, centered with padding on desktop
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use cards from Aceternity UI Pro

userStories.title: Social Proof / Trust Section
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see that others trust and use Petal GTD.
acceptanceCriteria: Display trust indicators (placeholder content)
'Trusted by X+ productive people' counter
Optional: logo cloud of companies/tools
Optional: featured testimonial quote
Minimalist design that doesn't distract from main content
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use logo-clouds or testimonials from Aceternity UI Pro

userStories.title: Call-to-Action Section
userStories.description: As a user, I want a clear final call-to-action before the footer to encourage signup.
acceptanceCriteria: Compelling headline: 'Ready to get things done?'
Brief value proposition reminder
Large, prominent 'Get Started Free' button
Secondary text: 'No credit card required'
Visually distinct section (gradient background or card style)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use cta-sections from Aceternity UI Pro

userStories.title: Footer Component
userStories.description: As a user, I want a footer with useful links and information.
acceptanceCriteria: Petal GTD logo and brief tagline
Navigation links: Features, Pricing, About, Contact
Legal links: Privacy Policy, Terms of Service
Social media icons (placeholder links)
Copyright notice with current year
Clean, minimal design consistent with page style
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use footers from Aceternity UI Pro

userStories.title: Responsive Design & Polish
userStories.description: As a user, I want the landing page to work well on all devices.
acceptanceCriteria: Test and fix layout issues on mobile (< 640px)
Test and fix layout issues on tablet (640px - 1024px)
Test and fix layout issues on desktop (> 1024px)
Ensure touch-friendly tap targets on mobile
Verify all animations are performant (no jank)
Add smooth scroll behavior for anchor links
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Dark Mode Support
userStories.description: As a user, I want the landing page to support dark mode to match my system preference.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement dark mode using next-themes or Tailwind dark mode
All sections properly styled for both light and dark modes
Theme toggle in navbar (optional, can default to system)
Smooth transition between themes
Images/mockups adapted for both themes (or use neutral backgrounds)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: SEO & Meta Tags
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to configure SEO meta tags for better discoverability.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure page title: 'Petal GTD - Beautiful Task Management'
Add meta description highlighting key benefits
Configure Open Graph tags for social sharing
Add favicon and app icons
